label: Rescue-Tag Gateway & MQTT
info: Alur Integrasi Telemetri LoRa 50 Hz Rescue-Tag: ESP32 Serial -> JSON Parser -> MQTT Broker -> Web Command Center

name: === RESCUE-TAG GATEWAY: LoRa 433 MHz -> Edge Parser -> Local MQTT Broker ===
info:
Arsitektur Pipeline Rescue-Tag:
1. Sumber Data: ESP32 LoRa Gateway (COM14, 115200 bps) serta 5 Simulator Uji Triage START.
2. Pemrosesan: Parser FEAT 50 Hz mengonversi string LoRa/1-Hop Relay menjadi payload JSON terstruktur.
3. Distribusi MQTT Lokal: Publikasi real-time ke Local Broker (127.0.0.1:1883) topik rescue/tag/data & rescue/tag/alert.
4. Pemantauan: Debug per node (Jam #01 Relawan, Jam #02 Pekerja, dan Alert Darurat SOS).

name: Parser FEAT -> JSON Terstruktur
